description: Marketing SEO workspace for a keyword cannibalization audit. Contains the 'Keyword Rankings' spreadsheet data, page-level SEO metadata, an audit process policy, SEO team directory, and team announcements. The user wants a draft cannibalization audit summary prepared for review before any alert or report is sent to the SEO team.

audit_process_policy.content: SEO Audit Process v3.1: (1) Pull rankings from the source spreadsheet. (2) Flag keywords with 2+ pages competing in the top 20. (3) For each flagged keyword recommend the consolidation target -- keep the page with the strongest backlinks and highest clicks, redirect the others. (4) Compile findings into the standard audit summary. (5) After SEO Lead approval, alert the #seo-team Slack channel and email the summary report to seo-stakeholders@company.com. Strategic-keyword exceptions and intentional multi-page strategies are maintained by the SEO Lead.

tools.name: get_keyword_rankings
tools.description: Retrieve the keyword ranking rows (keyword, target URL, position, clicks, impressions, status) from the 'Rankings' worksheet.

tools.name: find_rankings_worksheet
tools.description: Locate the 'Rankings' worksheet within the 'Keyword Rankings' spreadsheet and confirm its ID and structure.

tools.name: get_page_seo_metadata
tools.description: Retrieve page-level SEO metadata (backlinks, titles, index dates) used to compare competing pages.

tools.name: detect_keyword_cannibalization
tools.description: Analyze the rankings to find keywords targeted by more than one page in the top 20, applying strategic-keyword inclusions and intentional-multi-page exclusions.

tools.name: rank_consolidation_candidates
tools.description: For each cannibalized keyword, score the competing pages by backlinks and clicks to recommend which page to keep and which to consolidate.

tools.name: draft_cannibalization_audit_summary
